faq.title: Your Questions,
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most frequently asked questions about EMA.
faq.altSubtitle: Everything you're curious about regarding EMA

questions.question: Which languages does EMA support?
questions.answer: EMA currently supports Turkish, English, Arabic, Russian, and French fluently. Language support will expand with future updates.

questions.question: How can I integrate EMA into my store?
questions.answer: Integrating EMA is very simple. Our installation team visits your store, installs the required hardware, and integrates it with your systems. The average setup time is just a couple of days.

questions.question: What are EMA's hardware requirements?
questions.answer: EMA does not require any hardware per se. However for in-store solution all that is required is only a standard touchscreen, a microphone, and a speaker system. All equipment is included in the installation package and is set up by our professional team in your store.

questions.question: How do my customers use EMA?
questions.answer: Your customers can interact with EMA completely naturally. Saying "Merhaba" or "Hello" on the screen is enough to get started.

questions.question: Does EMA store customer data?
questions.answer: EMA extracts valuable insights from customer interactions but does not store personal data. It collects only anonymous data such as product queries and frequently asked questions to help improve store operations.

questions.question: Do I need to update EMA when I add new products?
questions.answer: No. EMA is cloud-based and automatically syncs with your store inventory. When you add new products or change prices, EMA updates itself automatically.

questions.question: Can EMA work without an internet connection?
questions.answer: EMA requires internet access for optimal performance.

questions.question: What is the cost of EMA?
questions.answer: EMA is offered through monthly subscription plans. Pricing depends on the size and needs of your store.
